notes.title: Achievements are now in!
notes.content: [h1][b]🚀 Achievements are here![/b][/h1][p]The [i]SOS Incident[/i] Demo and Main App now feature [b]10 unique achievements[/b] to unlock. They’re hidden across the game and reward those who explore, experiment, and push their limits.
